project: Optimizing Ocean Alkalinity Enhancement: Balancing Atmospheric Carbon Removal and Marine Carbonate Chemistry
status: Phase 1 - scientific design, no dataset generated yet (generation begins only after the Revision 1 corrections are approved)
revision: R1 (2026-08-24): corrections adopted from external design review - dose-label reconciliation, refined baseline-chemistry generation (zone-specific Lee et al. 2006 equations), stricter stress-test labeling of upper doses, separation of kinetic equilibration fraction f from thermodynamic efficiency eta, tiered particle-dependent precipitation-risk framework replacing the universal Omega~5 threshold, flag-not-remove outlier policy, and a per-row carbonate-constants policy for cold water. Full changelog: section 16 of oae/phase1_scientific_design.md
description: Structured reference tables extracted from oae/phase1_scientific_design.md

files.dose_levels.json: The 12-level alkalinity-addition treatment ladder and justification for each range
files.environment_archetypes.json: The 6 baseline ocean environment archetypes and their sampling ranges
files.equations_and_constants.json: Carbonate-system equations, equilibrium constants, and the software used to solve them
files.validation_rules.json: The 14-rule dataset validation and sanity-check table
files.sources.json: Parameter/claim -> scientific source -> why it is used, including items still flagged for verification
